item_id.description: EXACT corpus filename without .txt. For a split session this ends in __partNN. Copy it verbatim from the header line of the corpus file / from todo.txt.

session_id.description: Copy the `SESSION <id>` value from the corpus header.

first_ts.description: ISO8601. For a split item use the part_window start; otherwise the session window start.

last_ts.description: ISO8601. Part window end, or session window end.

directive_violations.description: Places where the agent broke a rule written in rubric/CLAUDE.md. Empty array if none.

rule.description: The CLAUDE.md section or rule name, e.g. 'Supabase Production Database — NEVER write directly' or 'CI green merge policy — STRICT'.

evidence_quote.description: VERBATIM substring copied from the transcript that shows the violation. Never paraphrase. Never invent.

skill_routing_misses.description: The agent hand-rolled something that a skill in rubric/skills-index.md already covers. Empty array if none.

skill.description: EXACT skill name from rubric/skills-index.md. Never invent a skill name.

what_was_run_instead.description: The actual command / tool sequence, quoted from the transcript.

why_plausible.description: The QUALITATIVE why: what made the agent miss the skill here. Discoverability? Wrong trigger words? The skill looked heavier than the task? Partial overlap? Be specific to THIS transcript.

improvement_signals.description: Recurring friction inside this item that suggests a rule, skill or tooling change. Empty array if none.

friction.description: What kept going wrong, with a quoted trace.

proposed_change.description: A concrete rule/skill/tool change that would remove it.

decision_candidates.description: Durable decisions made in this item that belong in a decision record. NOT task chatter.

decision_text.description: One sentence, in the imperative or declarative. What was decided.

evidence_pointer.description: <item_id>@<ISO timestamp>. A POINTER ONLY — never paste a transcript dump here.

tainan_corrections.description: Every moment Tainan corrected, overruled, or pushed back on the agent. USER messages only. Empty array for subagent items (Tainan is not present there).

quote.description: VERBATIM from a USER message. Keep the original language (Portuguese stays Portuguese).

topic.description: What the correction was about, in a short noun phrase.

skill_gaps.description: A repeated multi-step bash/tool shape with NO covering skill in rubric/skills-index.md. If a skill covers it, that is a skill_routing_miss, not a gap.

command_shape.description: The generalized shape, e.g. 'ssh dokploy-vps -> docker ps | grep <app> -> docker logs --tail'.

description.description: What the shape accomplishes and why a skill would help.

links.description: PR URLs, plan slugs/URLs, issue URLs that appear in the transcript. Verbatim. Max 15.

knowledge_nuggets.description: Durable, reusable facts learned here — a footgun, a mechanism, a constraint. NOT task status.

claim.description: The fact, stated so it is useful without the transcript.

where_it_belongs.description: CLAUDE.md section, a claude-md/ companion doc, a specific skill, a repo README, or 'knowledge-tree'.
